questions.question: In the divine assembly, God asks the gods how long they will keep doing what?

answers.text: Judging unjustly and favoring the wicked
Ignoring the feasts and the sacrifices
Refusing to hear any cases at all

questions.question: In Asaph's psalm, God tells the gods in the divine assembly to defend the cause of whom?
In Asaph's psalm, God calls the gods sons of the Most High. What does He say will happen to them?

answers.text: They will be scattered among the nations
They will be turned into servants

questions.question: Asaph's psalm asks God to arise and judge the earth. What reason does it give?

answers.text: All the nations are His inheritance
The rulers have all stepped down
The nations have asked Him to
